H_hierarchical.evidence: The paper defines a flat FSM with three states: Idle, Pump ON, and Pump OFF; no parent/child or composite-state structure is described.

G_guards_arith.evidence: Threshold guards are explicitly given: Pump ON if VADC < 1000, Pump OFF if VADC > 3600, otherwise no change; LED ranges also compare VADC against the same bounds.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: The FSM drives concrete outputs: relay/pump control and 7-bit LED indications for low, medium, and full water levels.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: The manual override/reset is described as forcing the controller back to Idle/safe state, including during pump operation.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: Core FSM information is concentrated in the System Architecture section: threshold algorithm, LED output mapping, and FSM design are adjacent and explicit.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Terms such as manual override and safe state imply operator-priority reset behavior beyond ordinary threshold transitions, though the reset-to-Idle effect is partly spelled out.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: Pump and LED actions are directly specified in the threshold algorithm and simulation scenarios rather than only in remote narrative prose.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: All guards are simple single-variable comparisons on VADC or reset; no multi-variable boolean/arithmetic guard is present.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: No composite or hierarchical state has its own entry/during/exit behavior.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: The paper says reset/manual override forces Idle, but does not explicitly state a from-any-state fault transition or layered global recovery rule.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: No composite-state initialization or pseudo-state chain exists.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: The sample has simple numeric threshold guards over VADC, but no rich boolean or multi-variable guard structure.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: Manual reset may be global in implementation, but the NL does not explicitly declare a cross-cutting from-any-state rule over three or more states.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Outputs are concrete actuator/display signals: relay, pump, and LEDs; no abstract log/publish/notify action is part of the controller.

key_nl_quotes: The system operates via a finite state machine (FSM) with three states: Idle, Pump ON, and Pump OFF. Transitions are based on water level thresholds and manual override.
Pump ON, if VADC < Vlow = 1000 (25%); Pump OFF, if VADC > Vhigh = 3600 (90%); No Change, otherwise.
one_line_pitch: A compact but usable stress case for threshold-guard extraction and actuator-output attribution, with manual reset adding a small recovery-path challenge.
rationale: This is a clear FSM sample with explicit threshold guards, relay/pump actions, LED outputs, and a manual reset-to-Idle path. However, it is flat, mostly single-variable, and lacks composite behavior or explicit global fault recovery, so it is better as a backup benchmark item than a top stress-test candidate.
